description:
Search BuySignal's live UK/Canada deal database across 20+ retailers.

BuySignal aggregates real-time price drops from major UK retailers
(Currys, Argos, John Lewis, Very, JD Sports, Foot Locker, Boots,
The Fragrance Shop, and more) and Canadian retailers (Best Buy Canada,
Canada Computers, Sport Chek, and more).

category.description:
"tech", "fashion", or "fragrance". Omit to search all
categories in that market.

limit.description: max number of results to return (default 20, max 50).

max_price.description:
only return deals at or below this sale price (GBP for
uk, CAD for ca).

min_discount.description:
only return deals with at least this discount
percentage off the original price.

query.description:
optional text to match against the deal title
(case-insensitive substring match).

name: search_deals
title: Search BuySignal Deals
